full_map.description: H3 / RQ3 tested over ALL 903 nodes per frame (original definition). Retained for continuity with earlier runs; diluted toward 0.5 by nodes far from every player — see 'active_footprint' for the primary result.

active_footprint.description: H3 / RQ3 tested over nodes with (ct_mu + t_mu) > EPSILON only, i.e. nodes within meaningful pre-sigmoid Gaussian influence range of at least one player. This is the primary Metric 3 result going forward. Will be all-None until team_agg.py is updated to persist ct_mu/t_mu.
